# Lode Dewulf

**Headline:** From Core Values to Results. To help you grow and your project succeed as your Independent Director (IDP-C), Consultant and Coach . And to make Patient Engagement the norm in medical care and in medicines development.
**Current role:** Chairperson Of The Board
**Seniority:** Director, General Management
**Location:** Belgium
**Experience:** 25 years
**LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/lodedewulf · 4,010 followers
**Description:** My purpose is to live and help live from Core Values to Positive Impact. Like Yoda I teach and practice this Force. My mission is to co-create a future with more health and more happiness, which I believe is both needed and achievable. Better health is a goal that applies to individuals as well as companies and society. Our healthcare ecosystem needs fundamental change to add more quality to our life, not just more quantity. Healthcare Businesses and Stakeholders can and need to create more value WITH and FOR patients. And medicine itself needs to move from disease charity to health empowerment of ALL citizens. I believe that the key lies in a person-centric approach: it is about you; it is not about me or the average. We are living in a unique time when this change is finally becoming a true possibility. Today my data can be captured, understood and used for better outcomes for me, outcomes that matter to me and my aspirations. It all starts by truly listening to understand the individual experience. And it ends with each of us taking accountability to act for our own health and well-being. As the Buddhists have said for centuries “Every human being is the author of his own health or disease.” This change requires both mobilization of minds and coalitions of willing. I am currently focused on delivering this in 3 chosen areas: > patient engagement in medicine development and care delivery > culture change within organizations aimed at delivering better health solutions > Personal development If my mission resonates with you then I'd love us to connect. Passionate future-centric change agent for improved health and well-being. Rapid and creative thinker who shares and inspires by connecting minds and hearts. Outspoken and focused to deliver better outcomes that matter to the individual.
